sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding a strong run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This should be a straightforward fixture on paper, as Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and arrive in poor form with five consecutive losses before a solitary win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town, looking to bounce back from their most recent draw and maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. Nearby, third-placed AFC Bridgnorth welcome Eccleshall in a meeting between a resurgent side (five wins in their last six) and a team in mixed form. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby between fourth and ninth respectively, with Casuals having won their last outing. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, Bilston currently sixth with solid recent form while Foley Meir sit thirteenth. Market Drayton Town face an uphill battle hosting third-from-bottom New Mills, with both sides showing inconsistent recent records. Cheadle Heath Nomads (second-bottom, in poor form) travel to Telford Town (bottom, also struggling), making for a clash between two of the division's weakest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both sides in the lower half and both seeking improvements. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, the division's bottom-placed side with just 2 points from 7 games. Finally, Shawbury United face Barnton at home, with Shawbury in a dismal run of five successive defeats while Barnton sit mid-table with more stable recent form.
